remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated, move-in-ready Cape nestled on a peaceful cul-de-sac in Norwalk. Featuring an inviting open floor plan with gleaming hardwood floors, this home offers both comfort and style. The bright and spacious family room boasts a cozy fireplace and a large bay window, filling the space with natural light. The updated kitchen leads seamlessly to a private deck-great for outdoor dining and relaxation.  The first floor includes a generously sized primary bedroom, a second bedroom, and two stylishly updated full bathrooms. Upstairs, you'll find another bedroom, along with a versatile bonus room. Outside, a charming private fenced in backyard leading through beautifully maintained gardens. This delightful home offers a blend of modern updates and classic charm in a desirable location close to stores, schools and highway. An easy commute to NYC adds the perfect touch of urban convenience to our suburban charm.
